title: Group actions and the class equation
summary: Groups acting on sets; orbits and stabilisers and the orbit–stabiliser relation; the action by conjugation, conjugacy classes and centralisers; the class equation; p-groups have nontrivial centre and groups of order p² are abelian; Burnside's counting theorem with geometric and switching-function examples.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is chapter 14 of Judson (Sections 14.1–14.3) with MIT student notes lectures 17–19 as a supplement.

preparation.description: Read Section 14.1 (groups acting on sets, orbits, stabilisers) and Section 14.3 (Burnside's counting theorem) from the chapter page.
Read Section 14.2: the class equation, Theorem 14.2.4 (p-groups have nontrivial centre) and Corollary 14.2.5 (groups of order p² are abelian).
Optional supplement: MIT student notes, lectures 17–19 (Group Actions; Stabilizer; Group Actions on G).
